title: China's Bicycle sharing WENT INSANE!
summary: An expat YouTuber in China shows how dockless bike-sharing, once loved, has been flooded by competing companies. Bikes pile up, get abandoned in odd places and are vandalised, with footage from around the city.
why: HN commenters point to it as a brief, accurate insider overview of what went wrong with oversupplied dockless bike sharing.

quote.text: I find this fellow's assessment accurate, if you want a brief overview.
